Poet Kavita Krishnan Criticizes Delhi Police Action at Jantar Mantar

Poet Kavita Krishnan has publicly criticized the Delhi Police for their actions at Jantar Mantar, where police were seen wielding batons. Krishnan's statement, "Do not raise your hand against the children of the country," was directed at the police personnel. The incident occurred during a protest at Jantar Mantar, prompting Krishnan's strong condemnation of the police's use of force.
